steps.content: [The street in summer]
Steam rises off the asphalt's surface under the blazing sun. Every car that passes stirs up a hot gust that sends the shimmering heat into a rippling swirl.
You lead Phanuel across a crosswalk, then hug the storefronts and turn into a side street before looping back to the main road. It's only then that you shake off every last reporter and fan.
Phanuel quietly follows you the whole way, always staying half a step behind you. Her hat and sunglasses are doing wonders, making the two of you look like just another pair of pedestrians.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're not going to ask where we're headed? Are you really okay with this?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Phanuel knows you're doing this for good reason, and I'm always happy to go along with anything!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Has it never occurred to you that I could be one of the bad guys? For instance... I could sell your schedule to the fans for good money.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But you won't.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And what makes you so sure of that?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: You haven't done anything bad to Phanuel. You're the one who made me see the script for what it was. So, I tried something different, and it felt great!

Even without a camera in sight, she nods along to her own words with a smile, as if giving herself a little pat on the back. Then, she turns to you, her gaze drifting past your shoulder toward a pair of passersby.
She sees two girls around her age, holding hands and sharing a single box of ice cream.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did you have any friends before you became an idol?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I think so...? I can't remember.
Her voice drops a little. As the two girls disappear into the crowd, she lowers her gaze.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You can't... remember? Then what about your family? Your past? Why is everything blank on your public profile?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I can't remember... I just can't.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza said Phanuel doesn't need any of that.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And what do you need, according to her?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Everything an idol needs. Phanuel practices hard every single day, you know.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Every day, I'd memorize scripts. I have an answer for every question, one that makes sure people would like me.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: And I know. You're sharp. You figured that out at the press conference.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Have you never thought about doing something else? Something an idol doesn't "need," so to speak?
For a moment, she considers your question. Or rather, she pretends to.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But Phanuel doesn't know what an idol doesn't need! I was born for this!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is that also something Eliza told you?
She nods proudly. Then something catches her eye, and she bounces over. It's a billboard on the street, currently playing promotional material for her concert.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You sure trust Eliza a lot. Most artists wouldn't trust their managers this much.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza needs me. I matter. She said I'm a natural beauty, a born star... We're going to put on the biggest concert ever and become the center of everything.
Should you call her naive? Ignorant? Or simply a masterful actress? You can't say for sure.
You continue onward; only now, your grip on her wrist has tightened. Your fingertips press against her pulse, searching for any irregularity, any crack in the facade.

Phanuel notices this as well. But she doesn't resist. Instead, she squeezes back with the same force, as if she's discovered some new game. Suddenly, a shriek rings out nearby, and you both look up at once.

Across the street, a few young fans have gathered around a Phanuel billboard and are taking photos together. They strike poses with their light sticks, completely oblivious to the fact that the very person on that billboard is standing right across from them, separated only by a crosswalk and the steady flow of passing cars.

Phanuel stands at the edge of the shade, eyes fixed on them behind the sunglasses. She watches as they cheer and scream for her. Watches as they raise their phones toward the glowing billboard, their faces glowing with pure, unadulterated joy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why do you trust me so much anyway? It's not like I'm Eliza.
Phanuel's gaze remains on the fans, but she leans slightly closer to you.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Because you said something to me that no one else ever had. Just like Eliza did. She's the only one who ever told me that I was born for the stage, that I could have everyone's love and admiration.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Seems to me that you both care about me a lot.
Heartbeat steady. No irregularities. She speaks of you and Eliza the way one might of family or close friends, even though she's long forgotten the concept of either.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Since you trust me, I have one more question.
You come to an abrupt stop at a traffic light.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...A month ago, around the time the BR-003 Observation Hub was attacked. What were you doing?
The red light counts down, second by second. The flickering numbers wash over Phanuel's face. Thirty. Twenty-nine. Twenty-eight...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I don't remember. Eliza plans everything for me. But I'm pretty sure whatever I was doing is public. You could just check my fans' posts. Why?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A big star who personally keeps up with her fans' posts...? Do you care a lot about them?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes! They write letters to Phanuel, cheer for me, and call out my name. I feel every bit of it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then, let's say your fans were being threatened and hurt right now, would you want to do something about it?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Of course!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And what if helping those Cherubs meant going up against Eliza?
The countdown passes its halfway point. Cars begin pulling to a stop in front of you, one by one.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I... No. There has to be some kind of misunderstanding...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Does this sound familiar to you—a fan smiles with pure bliss the moment they see you, then loses consciousness right after?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...I'm not sure.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What do you mean, you're not sure?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'm not sure what kind of smile you mean. Everyone smiles at every single one of Phanuel's shows. I don't understand why you'd call that a sickness...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Have you ever done something that felt normal at the time, but feels a little off now that you look back at it?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza said it was all for my own good.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just answer yes or no.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes...
Looks like she's not used to you being so serious.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Did you ever ask Eliza why she had you do those things?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Have you ever considered that maybe Eliza has some kind of ulterior motive?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ever come across something that might be a clue, then?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Eliza always meets with someone at night to report things about me, saying things I can't understand.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: And no one's ever allowed near her office... Do these count?
The countdown ends. The red light shifts to green, just as usual. The crowd moves on. Only the two of you remain in place.

Phanuel tilts her head, unsure what's gotten into you. Then, she gives your hand a little shake. When you still don't respond, she doesn't push it. She glances to the side, just in time to see a group of fans who've finished taking their photos, now walking toward you.

Unlike most celebrities, she doesn't seem concerned about being recognized. If anything, it's like she wants it to happen. Those Cherubs seem to form a pure utopia, with Phanuel being the only thing in that world. Even the star herself is caught up in their excitement.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What if those people all collapsed the next moment, smiles frozen on their faces forever, lost to the Hollow Syndrome? What would you do?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I don't know...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stop with those scripted answers. Tell me what you think.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What "I" think...? I... I don't know...
